My Lianna,

Happy Girlfriend's Day ❤️

It's funny how someone who's miles away can still become my favorite part of every day. Even though we're in a long-distance relationship, you've made me realize that love isn't measured by how close we are, but by how much we choose each other.

Thank you for every late-night conversation, every laugh, every "good morning" and "good night," and even for all the Mobile Legends games we've played together. Those matches may seem simple to everyone else, but to me, they're little moments where I get to spend time with you, and I treasure every one of them.

I know I'm still courting you, but even now, all I want is to make you the happiest girl in the world. I want to be someone who gives you reasons to smile, someone who stays by your side through every win, every loss, and every challenge life throws at us. Whether we're playing together, or talking for hours, every moment with you is already enough to make me happy.

So on this Girlfriend's Day, even if we're miles apart, I hope you never forget how deeply you are appreciated and cherished. Distance may keep us from holding each other's hands, but it could never stop my heart from choosing you every single day.

Lianna, if the stars were given names, I'd still search for yours among them. If every sunrise carried a promise, mine would always be to love you a little more than I did yesterday. And until the day I can finally be with you, I'll keep crossing every distance with nothing but my sincerity, my patience, and this heart that has quietly fallen for you.

Happy Girlfriend's Day, my Lianna. Thank you for letting me be part of your days, your laughter, and your heart. I hope that one day, this distance will just become another story we'll smile about, because in the end, no matter how far you are, you'll always be my favorite place to come home to.

With all my love,
always.
